Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 84. Category: form. Oozaru.

Transformation
In this form, the Saiyan’s hair color differs, the same
goes for the tail and the body is covered in red fur. A
Saiyan in this form also possesses a shadow trim
around their eyes and over the eyelids that varies in
color, such as crimson.
Increase your Power by +3
You deal an additional 1d8 to all damage
You gain the Empowered Condition
Increase your Movement Speed by 30 ft.
You gain a +4 to your Maximum and Current
Strength and Dexterity Ability Score
At the end of your turn, you lose 4 Stamina
This Form is also part of the Super Saiyan Form
Family.
